units.rawText: Whew... Good thing we shook off Faith and company. Fortunately, she's more simpleminded than most. Another Sanctifier would probably have been trickier...
units.displayText: Whew... Good thing we shook off Faith and company. Fortunately, she's more simpleminded than most. Another Sanctifier would probably have been trickier...

spans.text: Whew... Good thing we shook off Faith and company. Fortunately, she's more simpleminded than most. Another Sanctifier would probably have been trickier...

units.rawText: Still, considering the girl made contact with the convoy, the Sanctifiers will probably make their way there soon, so we need to hurry.
units.displayText: Still, considering the girl made contact with the convoy, the Sanctifiers will probably make their way there soon, so we need to hurry.

spans.text: Still, considering the girl made contact with the convoy, the Sanctifiers will probably make their way there soon, so we need to hurry.

units.rawText: I return to Riko's convoy.
units.displayText: I return to Riko's convoy.

spans.text: I return to Riko's convoy.

units.rawText: Hey! Hey! Who are you? Look, if you're asking me to choose between my money and my life, I'd appreciate a little more time to think about the matter...
units.displayText: Hey! Hey! Who are you? Look, if you're asking me to choose between my money and my life, I'd appreciate a little more time to think about the matter...

spans.text: Hey! Hey! Who are you? Look, if you're asking me to choose between my money and my life, I'd appreciate a little more time to think about the matter...

units.rawText: Hm? Professor? Why are you dressed like that? You scared Riko, I was wondering what kind of Irregular Agent you were.
units.displayText: Hm? Professor? Why are you dressed like that? You scared Riko, I was wondering what kind of Irregular Agent you were.

spans.text: Hm? Professor? Why are you dressed like that? You scared Riko, I was wondering what kind of Irregular Agent you were.

units.rawText: I'm just on a secret mission, that's all.
units.displayText: I'm just on a secret mission, that's all.

spans.text: I'm just on a secret mission, that's all.

units.rawText: A secret mission? Ah, could it be that your little scuffle with the Sanctifiers just now was also...
units.displayText: A secret mission? Ah, could it be that your little scuffle with the Sanctifiers just now was also...

spans.text: A secret mission? Ah, could it be that your little scuffle with the Sanctifiers just now was also...

units.rawText: I'll tell you about it later. Speaking of which, since these goods are going to the Oasis, can I inspect your trailer?
units.displayText: I'll tell you about it later. Speaking of which, since these goods are going to the Oasis, can I inspect your trailer?

spans.text: I'll tell you about it later. Speaking of which, since these goods are going to the Oasis, can I inspect your trailer?

units.rawText: Sure you can, for a small fee...
units.displayText: Sure you can, for a small fee...

spans.text: Sure you can, for a small fee...

units.rawText: Yeah, sure, whatever.
units.displayText: Yeah, sure, whatever.

spans.text: Yeah, sure, whatever.

units.rawText: I call for the girl as I search the trailer.
units.displayText: I call for the girl as I search the trailer.

spans.text: I call for the girl as I search the trailer.

units.rawText: Can you hear me? We've come to bring you back to the Oasis...
units.displayText: Can you hear me? We've come to bring you back to the Oasis...

spans.text: Can you hear me? We've come to bring you back to the Oasis...

units.rawText: <color=orange>...Miss "Mayushii"?</color>
units.displayText: ...Miss "Mayushii"?

spans.text: ...Miss "Mayushii"?

units.rawText: Who are you looking for, Professor? There's nobody here... Hm? Why is this trailer door open?
units.displayText: Who are you looking for, Professor? There's nobody here... Hm? Why is this trailer door open?

spans.text: Who are you looking for, Professor? There's nobody here... Hm? Why is this trailer door open?

units.rawText: I shake my head. There's nobody in the trailer apart from a bag of bananas and fried chicken. There's a broken phone in the corner, but its owner is nowhere to be found.
units.displayText: I shake my head. There's nobody in the trailer apart from a bag of bananas and fried chicken. There's a broken phone in the corner, but its owner is nowhere to be found.

spans.text: I shake my head. There's nobody in the trailer apart from a bag of bananas and fried chicken. There's a broken phone in the corner, but its owner is nowhere to be found.

units.rawText: ...The Sanctifiers will be here soon. Dump your cargo and come with me, Riko.
units.displayText: ...The Sanctifiers will be here soon. Dump your cargo and come with me, Riko.

spans.text: ...The Sanctifiers will be here soon. Dump your cargo and come with me, Riko.

units.rawText: Ehhhh?! But Riko went through all that effort into bringing this shipment here...
units.displayText: Ehhhh?! But Riko went through all that effort into bringing this shipment here...

spans.text: Ehhhh?! But Riko went through all that effort into bringing this shipment here...

units.rawText: You can't make money when you're dead! Now hurry up and go!
units.displayText: You can't make money when you're dead! Now hurry up and go!

spans.text: You can't make money when you're dead! Now hurry up and go!

units.rawText: Are things really that bad... In that case, let's escape in my van!
units.displayText: Are things really that bad... In that case, let's escape in my van!

spans.text: Are things really that bad... In that case, let's escape in my van!

units.rawText: Your van? What van?
units.displayText: Your van? What van?

spans.text: Your van? What van?

units.rawText: This one, of course~
units.displayText: This one, of course~

spans.text: This one, of course~

units.rawText: Riko gets into a kei van that's parked beside the convoy. Its cartoon decals are very much her style.
units.displayText: Riko gets into a kei van that's parked beside the convoy. Its cartoon decals are very much her style.

spans.text: Riko gets into a kei van that's parked beside the convoy. Its cartoon decals are very much her style.

units.rawText: Hop on, Professor! This is a free ride from Riko, for a limited time only!
units.displayText: Hop on, Professor! This is a free ride from Riko, for a limited time only!

spans.text: Hop on, Professor! This is a free ride from Riko, for a limited time only!

units.rawText: Just then, my communicator goes off.
units.displayText: Just then, my communicator goes off.

spans.text: Just then, my communicator goes off.

units.rawText: Professor, you should be safe now, right? I have important news to pass on.
units.displayText: Professor, you should be safe now, right? I have important news to pass on.

spans.text: Professor, you should be safe now, right? I have important news to pass on.

units.rawText: While you were on your mission, a <color=orange>mysterious building</color> suddenly appeared in an empty lot in the Oasis.
units.displayText: While you were on your mission, a mysterious building suddenly appeared in an empty lot in the Oasis.
